issues.title: JWT callback queries DB on every token refresh
issues.detail: The `jwt` callback calls `db.user.findFirst` by email on every invocation, meaning every authenticated request that refreshes the token hits the database. There is no caching.

issues.title: Deleting a user is blocked by posts
issues.detail: The posts FK uses `onDelete: Restrict` while accounts and sessions use `Cascade`. Deleting a user who has any posts will fail with a foreign key constraint error — posts must be deleted first.

issues.title: Second migration drops foreign keys without re-adding them
issues.detail: The Stripe migration drops the three foreign keys (accounts, sessions, posts) but never re-creates them. Referential integrity then depends on Prisma's application-level checks, not the database.
